ideas.pitch: Real-time commuter bottleneck forecasting and predictive rerouting platform built for Vancouver public transit using historical congestion data.
ideas.title: RainCity Transit Pulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the pattern of high-scoring predictive models like the AI incident forecasting project by combining regression modeling with localized real-time data, which always appeals to judges looking for tangible municipal utility.

ideas.pitch: Decentralized carbon credit tracking and micro-transaction verification dashboard tailored for Pacific Northwest localized energy co-ops.
ideas.title: Pacific Microgrid Carbon Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven execution strategy of the GreenNovation AI platform by addressing a prominent regional sustainability theme with an interactive multi-agent analytics pipeline.

ideas.pitch: Satellite imagery processing dashboard for automated anomaly detection in local maritime shipping lanes and coastal waters.
ideas.title: Salish Sea Spill Early Warning System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the runner-up GeoNex-ATLAS project by demonstrating difficult computer vision and environmental monitoring applied directly to local geographic challenges.

ideas.pitch: Predictive analytics tool combining weather patterns and topographical data to forecast wildfire spread risks for regional forestry management.
ideas.title: BC Forestry Risk Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies a rigorous probabilistic forecasting engine similar to the Apart Research AI forecasting winner, giving judges an immediate high-impact safety application.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered patient acquisition and trust verification workflow built specifically for small dental and health clinics in British Columbia.
ideas.title: Coast-to-Coast Clinic Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly replicates the prize-winning formula of the Global-Smile patient acquisition engine by delivering a polished, vertical-specific SaaS tool within a tight hackathon timeframe.
